description: Free local LoRA training studio: build character, style and concept datasets from one photo or a big image folder, caption them (JoyCaption, prose or booru tags), train LoRAs with ai-toolkit for Krea 2, FLUX.1, FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image 2.1, Z-Image, SDXL and Anima, then compare checkpoints side by side. ComfyUI-powered, self-hosted.
